name: YtReader
tagline: Read YouTube subtitles with AI-powered text cleaning
blurb: YtReader turns YouTube into a focused reading experience.
description:
YtReader turns YouTube into a focused reading experience. Search for videos, follow subtitles with synchronized highlighting, and save the parts that matter.

Features

• Browse and search YouTube videos

• Read subtitles with synchronized word highlighting

• AI-powered subtitle text cleaning (OpenAI-compatible API, bring your own key)

• Organize videos into collections

• Highlight and annotate text

• Adjustable font, size, and line height for comfortable reading

• Light, dark, and system themes

• Home screen widget for quick access to your library

Privacy

• No account required

• No tracking or analytics

• AI features are opt-in and use your own API key

• All data stored locally on your device

Source code

YtReader is free and open source software licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0. The source code is available on GitHub.
